messages:
alex: Putting this here  seeing intermittent apiserver 502/504s hitting controlplane in eu-west-3 since ~11:02 UTC. GPU attach ops are failing with timeouts, some pods stuck in ContainerCreating.

infra-bot: [ALERT] apiserver: 5xx spike (eu-west-3)  11:05:12Z  4.8% 

tina: any correlation with NAT/egress? previous incidents have been SNAT-related.

lee: quick glance at cloudwatch: gateway-nat-main-euw3 showing conntrack_count ~ 64000 and ephemeral port exhaustion warnings. also saw a bunch of short TCP>KEEPALIVE resets to 10.0.0.1:6443.

alex: controller-manager logs show leader election churn and lease renew timeouts. pasting snippet:
```
E0312 11:03:58.987 1 leaderelection.go:289] error retrieving resource lock kube-system/controller-leader: Get "https://10.0.0.1:6443/api/v1/namespaces/kube-system/endpoints/controller-leader": read tcp 10.0.10.12:52344->10.0.0.1:6443: read: connection reset by peer
W0312 11:04:00.105 1 lease_renew.go:102] failed to renew lease: context deadline exceeded
I0312 11:04:02.211 1 election.go:78] attempting to acquire leader lease
```

maria: etcd metrics show leader changes too but leader appears stable; latency spikes around the same time (etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration high for a few seconds).

lee: looks like a classic egress saturation -> apiserver connections drop -> ctrlmgr can't renew -> leader election storms -> controller churn -> heavy PodAttach retries hitting GPU pool API and causing attach latency.

tina: mitigation plan suggestions?

alex: short-term fixes:
- add a second NAT gateway and shift egress route table for controlplane subnets to split traffic
- temporarily increase controller-manager flags: `--leader-elect-lease-duration=45s --leader-elect-renew-deadline=30s --leader-elect-retry-period=10s` for the eu-west-3 deploy only
- lower PodAttach concurrency on kubelet for GPU nodes to reduce outgoing connections to attach service

ops-bot: creating infra task: provision additional NAT gw (eu-west-3) 

lee: provisioning new NAT now (elastic IPs allocating). ETA 7m.

maria: recommend also enabling conntrack early-eviction to keep table from full-blocking. current system: conntrack_max=262144 but `nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established` default is high; we can tune TCP timeouts for shorter lived connections to reclaim ports faster.

alex: agree, and add synthetic probe: controller-manager lease API probe across zones that faults when we see >5 lease renew failures in 1m.

tina: I'll open PR for kube-controller-manager patch. applying to eu-west-3 as canary. pls paste kubectl patch I can use.

alex: running this canary patch now:
```
kubectl -n kube-system patch deployment kube-controller-manager --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"kube-controller-manager","command":["/bin/kube-controller-manager","--leader-elect=true","--leader-elect-lease-duration=45s","--leader-elect-renew-deadline=30s","--leader-elect-retry-period=10s"]}]}}}}'
```

ops-bot: deployment patch accepted for kube-controller-manager (eu-west-3)  rollout 1/1

lee: after patching, reconcile latency improved within ~70s. apiserver 5xxs reduced to 0.6% and GPU attach timeout errors dropped.

maria: NAT gateway provisioned and added to route table. conntrack reclaim metrics show counts dropping, ephemeral ports freed.

tina: follow-ups / action items:
- infra: make NAT gateway autoscaleable for controlplane egress and add alert for high conntrack_count 
- infra: tune conntrack tcp timeout params and document expected values per region 
- platform: add synthetic lease-renew probe and dashboard (threshold alerting) 
- platform: throttle kubelet PodAttach concurrency on GPU node pools to reduce bursty egress to attach service 
- finance: estimate cost delta for permanent second-NAT vs ALB/NLB egress redesign

alex: i'll draft a short incident note and link to runbook. assigning postmortem to @maria.

maria: assigned. will include root cause analysis: SNAT port exhaustion + transient etcd fsync latency amplifying controller churn -> attach retries. postmortem due 24h.

lee: tagging cost estimate to @tina for AWS NAT hourly/EIP considerations.

tina: noted. thanks folks. moving to retrospective channel. :white_check_mark:
